messages:
Haruto S.: Hey everyone :wave: I’m Haruto — joined today as Backend Eng (infra/runtime). Big into sunrise rides and matcha. Moved from Kyoto; on weekdays I do a 6:15am loop. Do we have a secure bike parking or a place to stash a helmet? Also curious about desk plant policy (low-light plants ok?). Glad to be here!

Lina (People Ops): Welcome Haruto! :tada: We have indoor bike racks in B1 and helmet lockers in the 1st-floor mail room. To register your bike, run `/bike-register HARUTO` or ping facilities. Plant policy is pretty relaxed — low-light pothos or snake plants are fine, just a drip tray for desks.

facilities-bot: Bike rack spots available: 3. To reserve: https://intranet.redwood/bike-racks — if you run `/bike-register HARUTO` you'll get a confirmation email.

Maya L.: welcome!! :wave: I cycle too — usually the 6:30 ferry route, would love to join a ride sometime.

Noah G.: If you like matcha, check the stall on 5th between A & B — they do a mean matcha latte. Also FYI desk 17B gets the best morning light if you want sun for plants.

Samira K.: Heads up: plants on hot desks need a drip-saucer. I can drop by later with a tiny watering tray :seedling: :thumbsup:

Haruto S.: Awesome, thanks everyone! I'll register now. Maya — ferry ride sounds great, morning commute buddies? :bicycle:

Maya L.: Yesss :raised_hands: DM me and we can coordinate weekly rides (weather permitting).

Lina (People Ops): Adding Haruto to the 'Morning Riders' thread and sending a welcome kit (tea + mug) to desk 17B. Also tagging facilities to confirm locker code.

Noah G.: Ramen recs: 'Tetsu' on Maple is my go-to for lunchtime. 'Ichi' has a matcha dessert on weekends if you want to celebrate your first month.

Haruto S.: :heart_eyes: Perfect — adding to my 'first-month eats' list. Thanks all, see you around the office :bow:
